records.sql:
SELECT SUM(approved_amount) AS total_approved_amount
FROM loans
WHERE contract_status = 'finished'
  AND payment_status = 'fully_paid'
  AND has_problems = FALSE;

SELECT AVG(monthly_payment) AS avg_monthly_payment
FROM loans;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_clients
FROM clients c
JOIN districts d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.average_salary > 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_clients
FROM clients c
JOIN accounts a ON c.client_id = a.account_owner_id
JOIN regions r ON a.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE r.region_name = 'Prague';

SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_transaction_amount
FROM transactions
WHERE account_id = 1
  AND transaction_date BETWEEN '1997-01-01' AND '1997-12-31';

SELECT
    d.name AS district_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT disp.client_id) AS owner_count
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.region = 'south Moravia'
GROUP BY d.name
ORDER BY owner_count DESC;

SELECT
    c.client_id,
    c.gender,
    SUM(a.loan_amount) AS total_loan_amount
FROM clients c
JOIN accounts a ON a.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE a.status = 'account owner'
GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender
ORDER BY total_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(l.loan_id) AS running_loans_good_standing
FROM loan l
JOIN account a   ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disposition d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c    ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE l.status IN ('A', 'C')          -- contracts in good standing
  AND l.status <> 'B'                 -- not in debt/bad standing
  AND di.A3 = 'north Bohemia';        -- region

FROM disp d

GROUP BY c.client_id, c.gender
ORDER BY total_loan DESC
